title: Badminton was fine. The walk home wasn't 😭
caption:
He survived badminton. The stairs did not 😭
After practice, he drags his racket bag up a staircase that never ends — until his legs give out and he plops down to call for backup, whispering "Can you come and help me, please?"
That too-tired-to-move-another-step moment is painfully relatable: sometimes all you need is one person willing to come get you.
Who do you call when your legs completely give up on you?
